supplements.title: Network pharmacology analysis of integration of dietary plant-derived natural flavonoids and gut microbiota for the treatment of Polycystic Ovary syndrome (PCOS).
supplements.summary: Plant flavonoids like luteolin and quercetin may treat PCOS by working with gut bacteria to regulate insulin and growth signaling pathways.

supplements.title: Targeting the gut microbiota as treatment for obesity and cancer cachexia.
supplements.summary: Modifying gut bacteria could treat both obesity and cancer cachexia by restoring normal metabolism and reducing inflammation.

supplements.title: Exercise and CD8+ T cells: mechanisms of immune modulation in antitumor responses.
supplements.summary: Exercise enhances immune cells' ability to fight tumors by improving their metabolism and reducing tumor-suppressing signals in the cancer environment.

supplements.title: Effects of Avocado (Persea americana) Fruit and Byproducts on Molecular Pathways Related to Oxi-inflammation: A Systematic Review of Randomized Clinical Trials.
supplements.summary: Avocado and its byproducts may reduce inflammation and oxidative stress, potentially helping prevent chronic diseases like diabetes and heart disease.

supplements.title: Quercetin and nanoquercetin mitigate high fat diet-induced obesity via lipid modulation, genomic DNA integrity restoration, adipokine regulation, and hepato-pancreatic tissue preservation.
supplements.summary: Quercetin and nanoquercetin reduce obesity and restore metabolic health by improving lipid profiles, protecting DNA, and preserving liver and pancreas tissue.

supplements.title: PRAS40 activates the IRE1α-XBP-1-mediated unfolded protein response to exacerbate colorectal cancer by enhancing ST6Gal1-dependent α-2, 6 sialylation of GRP78.
supplements.summary: PRAS40 protein drives colorectal cancer growth by activating a stress response pathway; blocking ST6Gal1 may slow tumors.

supplements.title: Mechanistic Investigation of RHEI FLOS extract Against Hepatocarcinoma via the PI3K/Akt Signaling Pathway In Vitro and In Vivo.
supplements.summary: Rhei Flos extract shows promise against liver cancer by blocking a specific cellular growth pathway in laboratory and animal studies.

supplements.title: A decoction-inspired genetic algorithm and PPO reinforcement learning for intelligent molecular discovery: Anti-colorectal cancer candidates from the tiao-pi AnChang formula.
supplements.summary: Researchers used artificial intelligence to identify anti-cancer compounds from a traditional Chinese herbal formula effective against colorectal cancer.

supplements.title: Red ginseng polysaccharide targets the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway to induce mitochondrial apoptosis in bladder cancer.
supplements.summary: Red ginseng polysaccharide kills bladder cancer cells by triggering a specific cellular pathway that causes mitochondrial cell death.

supplements.title: Morphologically adaptive microconical hydrogels of gelatin/polyvinyl alcohol with curcumin for diabetic wound repair.
supplements.summary: Researchers developed an adaptive gel dressing with curcumin that conforms to wound surfaces, significantly speeding diabetic wound healing through multiple biological mechanisms.

supplements.title: Copper deprivation reprograms antioxidant defense to suppress ferroptosis via SLC7A11.
supplements.summary: Copper deprivation protects cells from ferroptosis by activating a pathway that strengthens antioxidant defenses, potentially enabling cancer resistance.

supplements.title: The double-edged sword of pyroptosis targeting in cancer therapy.
supplements.summary: Pyroptosis shows promise in killing cancer cells and boosting immunity, but risks include toxicity and cancer cells' ability to evade this cell death mechanism.

supplements.title: Dimethyl bisphenolate inhibits ovarian cancer growth by regulating the PI3K/AKT/mTOR signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Dimethyl bisphenolate, a new compound, slows ovarian cancer growth by disrupting a key cell signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Simultaneous quantification of active ingredients after the combination of Shenqi Fuzheng injection and docetaxel in vitro and in rabbits.
supplements.summary: Researchers found that combining traditional Chinese medicine with docetaxel chemotherapy alters active ingredient concentrations and pharmacokinetics in breast cancer treatment.

supplements.title: BCL-2 Mediated Apoptotic Pathway as Promising Target for Bio- Synthesized Silver Nanoparticles: A Review Article.
supplements.summary: Bio-synthesized silver nanoparticles trigger cancer cell death by activating the BCL-2 apoptotic pathway across multiple cancer types.

off_label.title: The 1p/19q co-deletion induces targetable and imageable vulnerabilities in glucose metabolism in oligodendrogliomas.
off_label.summary: A genetic change in oligodendrogliomas creates a weakness in how cancer cells use glucose, offering new treatment and detection opportunities.

off_label.title: Propranolol enhances the oncolytic effect of newcastle disease virus on canine mammary tumor cell by modulating the IFN-I-mediated JAK-STAT signaling pathway.
off_label.summary: Propranolol enhances a cancer-killing virus's effectiveness against canine breast tumors by suppressing immune signals that normally block viral replication.

off_label.title: From Biomarker to Drug Target: Integrating ceRNA Networks and Pharmacogenomics to Reposition C5orf34 in Uterine Corpus Endometrial Cancer Therapy.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified C5orf34 as a potential new drug target for uterine cancer that could improve patient outcomes and treatment options.

off_label.title: Clomiphene citrate in the management of anovulation: a review of mechanisms, outcomes, and clinical challenges.
off_label.summary: Clomiphene citrate effectively treats anovulation by stimulating ovulation, though treatment success varies based on individual factors and has notable limitations.

off_label.title: Enhanced antitumor activity of atorvastatin and luteolin, with or without doxorubicin, in a solid Ehrlich carcinoma mouse model: modulation of ABC transporters, telomerase, and cancer stem cells.
off_label.summary: Atorvastatin and luteolin combination therapy effectively reduced solid Ehrlich carcinoma tumors by targeting chemoresistance mechanisms.

off_label.title: Second-generation prokineticin PKR1 receptor agonists: Advancing cardioprotection against chemotherapy-induced toxicity.
off_label.summary: A new drug called IS39 protects the heart from damage caused by doxorubicin chemotherapy in cancer treatment.

off_label.title: Alterations in the testicular lipidome after tumor irradiation and their potential modulation by long-term losartan treatment.
off_label.summary: Losartan treatment may help protect testicular function and fertility in cancer patients receiving radiation therapy by reducing radiation-induced lipid damage.

off_label.title: Endoscopic application of tranexamic acid and sucralfate in upper gastrointestinal bleeding: A randomized controlled trial.
off_label.summary: Applying tranexamic acid and sucralfate directly to bleeding sites during endoscopy reduces rebleeding in difficult upper gastrointestinal cases.

off_label.title: Ultrasound-Responsive Dual-Prodrug Nanoassembly for 'Fenestrae-Restoration Strategy' in Liver Fibrosis Therapy.
off_label.summary: Researchers developed ultrasound-activated nanoparticles that restore liver blood vessel openings, allowing anti-fibrosis drugs to reach and stop liver scarring progression.

off_label.title: Targeting WIP1 reprograms immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment to potentiate immunotherapy response in colorectal cancer.
off_label.summary: Blocking WIP1 protein in colorectal cancer reactivates immune cells and improves immunotherapy effectiveness when combined with STING activation.

off_label.title: Overcoming vascular niche-mediated TKI resistance in acute myeloid leukemia through miR-126 inhibition.
off_label.summary: Blocking miR-126 in leukemia cells combined with tyrosine kinase inhibitors overcomes drug resistance and prevents AML relapse.

off_label.title: Histone lactylation-driven feedback loop modulates pyrimidine metabolism to promote oral carcinogenesis.
off_label.summary: Blocking lactate-driven histone modifications in oral cancer cells reduces tumor growth by disrupting a metabolic feedback loop.

off_label.title: SGLT2 inhibitors mitigate cardiorenal toxicity and improve survival in type 2 diabetes mellitus patients undergoing antineoplastic therapy: A multicenter retrospective cohort study.
off_label.summary: SGLT2 inhibitors reduced heart disease by 86% and death by 85% in diabetic cancer patients receiving chemotherapy.

off_label.title: Ferroptosis Induction by Fenbendazole Combined With Photothermal Therapy Triggers Dual-Immunotherapy Against Bladder Cancer.
off_label.summary: Combining a drug with heat therapy triggers immune-boosting cell death in bladder cancer tumors.

off_label.title: EZH2 inhibition in resistant glioblastoma stem cells counteracts oxidative stress protection and triggers ferroptosis.
off_label.summary: EZH2 inhibition triggers ferroptosis in drug-resistant glioblastoma stem cells, overcoming their oxidative stress protection and inducing cell death.

biomarkers.title: Immune cell clustering identifies a CD163⁺/CSF1R⁺ macrophage and neutrophil-enriched phenotype with distinct biological signatures and poor prognosis in angiosarcoma.
biomarkers.summary: High levels of CSF1R-expressing macrophages in angiosarcoma identify aggressive tumors and poor survival outcomes.

biomarkers.title: The MYBL2-GTSE1 axis promotes laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma progression by regulating PI3K/AKT-dependent glycolytic reprogramming.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers found that blocking the MYBL2-GTSE1 pathway may slow laryngeal cancer growth by reducing cancer cells' ability to use sugar for energy.

biomarkers.title: Extracellular payload release from non-internalizing antibody-drug conjugates: mechanisms and linker technologies.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed non-internalizing antibody-drug conjugates that release cancer-killing drugs outside cells, overcoming resistance and improving treatment effectiveness.

biomarkers.title: Network pharmacology analysis of integration of dietary plant-derived natural flavonoids and gut microbiota for the treatment of Polycystic Ovary syndrome (PCOS).
biomarkers.summary: Plant flavonoids like luteolin and quercetin may treat PCOS by working with gut bacteria to regulate insulin and growth signaling pathways.

biomarkers.title: Pilot study on cannabis-induced alterations in platelet function: implications for transfusion medicine.
biomarkers.summary: Cannabis exposure altered platelet function in lab tests, potentially affecting transfusion safety, though clinical impact requires further study.

biomarkers.title: Prediction of high-risk factor in early-stage lung cancer: micropapillary adenocarcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified risk factors for a dangerous lung cancer subtype to help doctors plan better treatment before surgery.

biomarkers.title: Application and mechanistic research of novel therapeutic strategies in cisplatin-resistant small cell lung cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers reviewed new treatment strategies to overcome cisplatin resistance in small cell lung cancer, including immunotherapy and targeted drugs.

biomarkers.title: Imaging-derived risk score predicts pain recurrence in osteoid osteoma patients undergoing radiofrequency ablation.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed an imaging score to predict which osteoid osteoma patients will experience pain after radiofrequency ablation treatment.

biomarkers.title: Synergistic effect of combined hyperthermia and radiotherapy mediated by AQP5 reduction in pancreatic cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Combined heat and radiation therapy effectively treats pancreatic cancer by reducing a water channel protein called AQP5.

biomarkers.title: Development of a novel immune infiltration-based gene signature to predict prognosis and immunotherapy response of a novel anti-PD-L1/TGF-β bifunctional fusion protein in recurrent cervical cancer.
biomarkers.summary: A gene signature predicts which recurrent cervical cancer patients will respond to a new dual immunotherapy drug targeting PD-L1 and TGF-β.

biomarkers.title: Cytomegalovirus Drives the Development of Cytotoxic CD4+ T Cells in Patients With Multiple Sclerosis.
biomarkers.summary: Cytomegalovirus infection triggers the development of killer CD4+ immune cells in multiple sclerosis patients.

biomarkers.title: CD47 stabilizes ROBO2 to regulate glioblastoma progression by preventing ITCH-mediated ubiquitination.
biomarkers.summary: CD47 protein promotes glioblastoma growth by stabilizing ROBO2, suggesting blocking this pathway could treat the cancer.

biomarkers.title: Stable or not? unraveling the reliability of radiomic features in 4d-computed tomography in early-stage non-small cell lung cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a method to identify reliable imaging features in 4D-CT scans for lung cancer treatment planning and radiotherapy prediction.

biomarkers.title: RagC and Map4K3 deficiency in high-grade gliomas drives proliferation and modulates mTORC1-dependent cellular functions.
biomarkers.summary: Loss of RagC and Map4K3 proteins in high-grade brain tumors increases cancer cell growth through altered mTOR signaling pathways.

biomarkers.title: Engineering the next generation of cellular therapies for solid tumors: multi-specific armored CARs and TME reprogramming strategies.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers are engineering enhanced CAR T-cell therapies with multiple targets and immune-boosting payloads to overcome solid tumor resistance and improve treatment effectiveness.

trials.title: Extracellular payload release from non-internalizing antibody-drug conjugates: mechanisms and linker technologies.
trials.summary: Researchers developed non-internalizing antibody-drug conjugates that release cancer-killing drugs outside cells, overcoming resistance and improving treatment effectiveness.

trials.title: Application and mechanistic research of novel therapeutic strategies in cisplatin-resistant small cell lung cancer.
trials.summary: Researchers reviewed new treatment strategies to overcome cisplatin resistance in small cell lung cancer, including immunotherapy and targeted drugs.

trials.title: Imaging-derived risk score predicts pain recurrence in osteoid osteoma patients undergoing radiofrequency ablation.
trials.summary: Researchers developed an imaging score to predict which osteoid osteoma patients will experience pain after radiofrequency ablation treatment.

trials.title: Development of a novel immune infiltration-based gene signature to predict prognosis and immunotherapy response of a novel anti-PD-L1/TGF-β bifunctional fusion protein in recurrent cervical cancer.
trials.summary: A gene signature predicts which recurrent cervical cancer patients will respond to a new dual immunotherapy drug targeting PD-L1 and TGF-β.

trials.title: Engineering the next generation of cellular therapies for solid tumors: multi-specific armored CARs and TME reprogramming strategies.
trials.summary: Researchers are engineering enhanced CAR T-cell therapies with multiple targets and immune-boosting payloads to overcome solid tumor resistance and improve treatment effectiveness.

trials.title: A retrospective analysis of risk-reducing salpingo-oophorectomy performed in women diagnosed with hereditary breast and ovarian cancer at our institution.
trials.summary: Removing ovaries and fallopian tubes significantly reduces cancer risk in women with hereditary breast and ovarian cancer syndrome.

trials.title: State-of-the-art and future developments in dosimetry for sstr- and PSMA-targeting radioligand therapies.
trials.summary: Personalized dosimetry could optimize radioligand therapy for prostate cancer and neuroendocrine tumors, but clinical adoption faces standardization and logistical barriers.

trials.title: Suppression of Indoleamine 2,3-Dioxygenase Enhances Immune Responses to the Therapeutic Vaccine for Chronic Hepatitis B.
trials.summary: Blocking an immune-suppressing enzyme enhances the body's immune response to a hepatitis B cancer vaccine.

trials.title: Limited reliability of H3K27M detection using a commercially available blood-based comprehensive genomic profiling test in patients with diffuse midline gliomas: analysis of the nationwide C-CAT database in Japan.
trials.summary: A blood test for diffuse midline glioma's H3K27M mutation shows limited reliability in detecting this key cancer marker.

trials.title: Pretreatment volume-based 18F-FDG PET/CT parameters as prognostic indicators in malignant peritoneal mesothelioma patients.
trials.summary: A PET scan measurement taken before treatment predicts survival outcomes in patients with peritoneal mesothelioma.

trials.title: ACR Appropriateness Criteria® Penetrating Trauma-Abdomen and Pelvis: Update 2026.
trials.summary: CT imaging with contrast is the recommended approach for evaluating suspected penetrating urinary tract injuries to guide treatment.

trials.title: ACR Appropriateness Criteria® Staging and Follow-Up of Adrenal Cancer.
trials.summary: MRI, CT, and PET scans are recommended to detect and monitor adrenal gland cancers and assess for spread or recurrence.

trials.title: Reduced initial Pazopanib dosing strategy for recurrent, advanced, or metastatic sarcoma: A single center experience.
trials.summary: Lower starting doses of pazopanib for metastatic sarcoma reduced side effects while maintaining similar effectiveness compared to standard dosing.

trials.title: Tissue Penetration of Gemcitabine and Gemcitabine Phosphate Metabolites Following Gemcitabine Intravesical System Administration Versus Standard Intravesical Instillation in a Preclinical Minipig Model.
trials.summary: A novel gemcitabine-releasing system maintains bladder cancer drug levels four times longer than standard instillation in preclinical testing.

trials.title: Advancing adoptive cellular immunotherapy via Notch-based ex vivo T cell development platforms.
trials.summary: Notch signaling platforms enable lab production of therapeutic T cells from stem cells, allowing off-the-shelf cancer immunotherapy treatments.
